order_options.title: Order Options
order_options.disallow_special_desc: When enabled, customers cannot add special instructions (e.g. notes for the kitchen) when adding or editing items in the cart.

order_options.single_deal_only_desc: When enabled, customers can only use one deal at a time (Free Item, Reward, Coupon, or BOGO) during checkout.
order_options.sms_verification_need_desc: When enabled, customers must verify their phone with a one-time code before paying online. Recommended if you had issues with fake or mistyped numbers.
order_options.disable_schedule_orders_desc: When enabled, customers can only place ASAP orders on your website. The schedule-a-time option is hidden at checkout.
order_options.ask_for_utensils_desc: When enabled, customers see a Need utensils? option on the checkout page. Off by default — the option is hidden on the customer site.
